changes.detail: D-128 (operator decision 2026-10-14) with the PR #92 review decisions, calibration.py and service.py. (1) A calibration trial over the per-trial token ceiling is recorded (trial ceiling_overrun and ceiling_tokens, run head overruns, summary warnings TRIAL_OVER_CEILING) and the run goes on; the root token budget, the active wall budget and the kill switch still stop it, and a recorded overrun no longer refuses the next reservation of a calibration root. The ceiling is judged by a cost-weighted uncached-equivalent count (raw tokens with the reason when a part cannot be priced or the weigher fails); the ledger and trial tokens stay raw (IC-34 amended for the judgement only). Stage experiments keep the stop. (2) A not_run trial settles at 0 tokens in calibrations and experiments. (3) CalibrationService.resume: completed graded trials kept, unfinished slots re-run, summary rewritten as a new revision; CALIBRATION_RESUME_CHANGED / _STATE / _UNRESOLVED / _STALE, META_WALL_BUDGET on active run time. (4) Optional plan fields imports and import_policy (expected_imported, drift reference and basis): v1 round-1 trials of other plans whose reuse key matches exactly (trial code digest, model snapshot, corpus, evaluator version or a trial_compatible_with one), paired cases only, within window_hours; provenance and a 0-charge allocation; a drift check on source-stable tasks drops a cell's imports when the Wilson 95 % lower bound of the flip share exceeds the cell's A/A discordance. Failure review: the drift sample floor min(n, drift_min_per_cell) with a top-up from non-flaky unstable tasks (else the cell is inconclusive before any run), at least 4 compared pairs for a verdict, reservations of max(ceiling, the largest raw trial of the root), the original qualification pinned at resume (CALIBRATION_RESUME_QUALIFICATION unless requalified), one trial deadline of wall time left for a resume, imports stored in the run-start transaction. (5) Summaries record partial and run_segment and leave imported-vs-re-run pairs out of aa_discordance; complete_summaries keeps a stopped run's summary out of every reader. trial_compatible_with eval-11: eval-12 changes accounting (charged tokens of not-run trials, the overrun stop, the wall clock), resume and import, and which summaries readers select; it does not change how a trial is graded (success, safety and unknown-effect handling, the receipt binding in service.py validate_observation and failed_trial are unchanged), so a trial recorded under eval-11 means the same under eval-12. In practice no eval-11 trial is reused: its receipt has no trial_code_digest, which never matches.
